diagnostics.message: The explicit depends_on from :resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default to :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin duplicates the ordering already inferred from the distribution's origin domain_name, which uses local.bucket_domain_name derived from aws_s3_bucket.origin.

The CloudFront distribution uses the S3 bucket as its origin, but it has no dependency on :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default. Ordering policy attachment before distribution creation avoids the distribution becoming active before the origin access policy is in place.
